title: New Leadership for Austin Housing & Redevelopment
summary:
*   Austin's Acting City Manager was appointed as the Acting General Manager for the Austin Housing Finance Corporation.
*   Ramiro Perez III was elected to the Board of Directors for the Austin Redevelopment Corporation.
